name: The Soldier
description: A soldier with a rifle, a vest, and a habit of standing where the trouble is. The party's line when everything is noise.

fields.drive: Protect someone who cannot protect themselves
fields.burden: A promise made to the dead
fields.scar: A bite scar you keep covered
fields.look: A uniform worn without the patches
fields.shelter_duty: Watch the wall and the dark
fields.personal_item: A dented canteen with a name scratched into it

name: The Preacher
description: A preacher with a relic, a book, and a voice that holds people together. The closest thing to magic the winter has left.

fields.drive: Find a cure, or the truth about the fall
fields.burden: A relic you should have thrown away
fields.look: A clean coat, somehow, and dirty boots
fields.background: Preacher, funeral worker, or con artist
fields.shelter_duty: Teach the children and the newcomers
fields.personal_item: A photograph of people you no longer name aloud

name: The Medic
description: A medic with a stocked kit, steady hands, and a clear-eyed view of what can and cannot be saved.

fields.burden: A person who depends on you
fields.scar: A hand that never healed straight
fields.look: Layers of scavenged clothing and a broken watch
fields.shelter_duty: Tend the sick and the wounded
